title: Joining the project in 1978; by 1979 no defense against remote viewing

tellings.quote: I got brought into the project in October of 78 by July of 79 we knew there was no defense against remote fuing

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who served as a remote viewer in a secret US Army programme at Fort Meade, Maryland, says that within a year of starting the team had learned there was "no defense" against remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places or things with the mind alone. He tells Michels he was brought into the project in October 1978, and that by July 1979 they knew this. If true, it would mean no secret could be fully shielded from a trained viewer.
